verdicts.unsure: Not judged yet; look at it in pond-preview, the captures or a study.
verdicts.dislike: Not wanted. Say why in notes so it is not proposed again.

items.thing: A calmer, GNOME/macOS-like interface on the DMS session
items.notes: The direction of the revamp: rounded, smooth, translucent, one palette with a good dark mode.

items.thing: Pond as the whole desktop session
items.notes: "Really not ready, and a lot of things I just don't like." Login session removed; pond-preview stays as a live reference.

items.thing: Folio's color schemes
items.notes: Kept as they are. Looks never change colors.

items.thing: One cohesive palette with a good dark mode across shell, apps and greeter
More rounded corners
items.notes: Panels 16 px, rows and windows 12 px (was 5 px everywhere). First seen in Pond.

items.thing: Smoother, unhurried transitions
items.notes: Controls 120 ms, panels 220-320 ms, pages 300-520 ms, springs for windows (was 40-90 ms). First seen in Pond.

items.thing: Transparency with blur behind shell surfaces
items.notes: Pond's own panels are mostly opaque; this is closer to macOS.

items.thing: Soft layered shadows under panels and windows
items.notes: Pond stacks five soft shadows under each panel.

items.thing: Sidebar with clock, calendar, media, notifications and quick controls
Workspace minimap; drag windows between workspaces
Claude Code / Codex terminal state on the minimap (working, needs input, unread)
Notification toasts, centre and sidebar card
Volume, brightness and keyboard-layout feedback
Update card and restart-recommended badge
Wi-Fi and Ethernet panel, including enterprise networks
Bluetooth panel
Audio output and input panel
Battery detail and power profiles
Pond's settings panels (displays, keyboard, mouse)
Daylight / Unthemed look and wallpaper picker
First-run manual and navigation tutorial
Lock screen with the shape-grid password field
Login screen
Plymouth boot and shutdown animation
Pond's Vicinae fork (Mod+Space)
Clipboard history (Mod+V)
Pond's kitty setup (70% opacity, JetBrains Mono, Pond theme)
Onest as the interface font
Dark Adwaita for apps
One Appearance place: theme, wallpaper, font, bar, windows, dock, animations, lock screen
items.notes: Omarchy 4.5 rc2 made it top-level. Omarchy's is a keyboard menu; ours would be a designed screen.

items.thing: A theme as a bundle: palette, wallpapers, preview, lock art, light and dark; last wallpaper remembered per theme
items.notes: Maps onto Azure Folio's collections (Doré, European Summer, Argentina).

items.thing: Visual picker for wallpapers and themes
items.notes: Omarchy: carousel of skewed cards (shell/plugins/image-picker), no Hyprland imports.

items.thing: A theme change as one event: visible apps recolor first, the rest after, one notification if anything fails
items.notes: bin/omarchy-theme-set builds, swaps atomically and ignores outdated recolors. Ours would drive themeport.

items.thing: Wallpaper and theme changes choreographed: cover, reveal, the bar fading along
items.notes: shell/plugins/background/Background.qml (slanted reveal).

items.thing: Panels that grow out of the bar and morph into each other, with press feedback
items.notes: New in 4.5 rc2. Needs a rewrite: Omarchy uses HyprlandFocusGrab.

items.thing: A screensaver before the lock, with idle timing owned by the shell
items.notes: omarchy-screensaver (Rust) animates ASCII art of your branding; dismissing it cancels the lock. Would be built from source.

items.thing: Notifications stacked by sender; actions, codes and links on the card; Do Not Disturb; a day of history
items.notes: 4.5 rc1/rc2. Its JS modules are portable; the service asks Hyprland for monitor and fullscreen state.

items.thing: Video wallpapers, with a still frame on the lock screen
items.notes: Omarchy's player (OWE) is Hyprland-only; would need another player that works on niri.

items.thing: One token file with a section per surface, so every screen draws from the same named colors and shapes
items.notes: Omarchy: shell.toml feeding Color and Style singletons. Ours would be emitted by themeport.

items.thing: One keyboard menu for every action, defined as data
items.notes: default/omarchy/omarchy-menu.jsonc; the same menu doubles as dmenu. Omarchy has no settings screens: Setup > Monitors opens a config file.

items.thing: Unlocking with a page turn
items.notes: "The book flipping is weird." Replaced: the page's print lifts, the paper slides aside, the art opens out.

items.thing: App icons in their own colors and shapes
items.notes: "Real app icons don't always have that tint." Original by default; plated and printed are options.

items.thing: A dock that never moves for other panels
items.notes: "The dock should not move with the sidebar." The sidebar stops above the dock's band instead.

items.thing: The plate's dither moving everywhere, in a loop
items.notes: Asked for instead of the diagonal light band.

items.thing: Moonlit plates in dark mode (picture's tones kept)
items.notes: "Dark mode really kills the vibe of the images." The UI's dark mode is liked as is.

items.thing: Nothing breaks with real content: long titles, many notifications, empty states
items.notes: "Pay extreme attention to things that could break the design." Every study gets Stress and Empty modes.

items.thing: One design language, Folio; no looks named after their sources
Interruptible springs everywhere, matched to niri's
